notebooks.title: 两支温度计与线性最小二乘

cells.code:
y = np.array([22.0,24.0])
R = np.array([4.0,1.0])
m, P = 20.0, 4.0
ordinary = float(np.mean(y))
precision = float(np.sum(1/R))
weighted = float(np.sum(y/R)/precision)
weighted_variance = 1/precision
posterior_variance = 1/(1/P+precision)
posterior_mean = posterior_variance*(m/P+float(np.sum(y/R)))
data_min = float(np.sum((y-weighted)**2/R)/2)
posterior_min = float(np.sum((y-posterior_mean)**2/R)/2+(posterior_mean-m)**2/(2*P))
print('LS_WLS_MAP', ordinary, weighted, posterior_mean)
print('LS_WLS_posterior_variances', float(np.sum(R)/4), weighted_variance, posterior_variance)
print('measurement_weights_posterior_precision', (1/R/precision).tolist(), 1/P+precision)
print('relative_curve_offsets', data_min, posterior_min)
assert np.allclose([ordinary,weighted,posterior_mean,weighted_variance,posterior_variance,data_min,posterior_min], [23,23.6,23,0.8,2/3,0.4,1.75],rtol=0,atol=1e-12)

H = np.array([[1.0,0.0],[1.0,1.0],[1.0,2.0]])
observed = np.array([1.0,2.0,2.0])
fit, _, rank, _ = np.linalg.lstsq(H, observed, rcond=None)
residual = observed-H@fit
print('vector_LS_rank_coefficients_SSE', rank, fit.tolist(), float(residual@residual))
assert rank == 2
assert np.allclose(fit,[7/6,1/2],rtol=0,atol=1e-12)
assert abs(float(residual@residual)-1/6)<1e-12
H_bad = np.ones((3,2))
candidate_a, candidate_b = np.array([5/3,0.0]),np.array([0.0,5/3])
print('rank_deficient_same_fit', int(np.linalg.matrix_rank(H_bad)), (H_bad@candidate_a).tolist(), (H_bad@candidate_b).tolist())
assert np.allclose(H_bad@candidate_a,H_bad@candidate_b,rtol=0,atol=1e-12)

notebooks.title: 偏差方差与噪声模型边界
notebooks.setupCode:
import numpy as np
from itertools import product

cells.code:
risk_rows = []
for truth in [20.0,22.0,26.0]:
    errors = []
    for e1,e2 in product([-2.0,2.0],[-1.0,1.0]):
        z1,z2 = truth+e1, truth+e2
        errors.append([(z1+z2)/2-truth, (z1+4*z2)/5-truth, (20+z1+4*z2)/6-truth])
    risk_row = np.mean(np.square(errors),axis=0).tolist()
    risk_rows.append([truth]+risk_row)
    print('truth_OLS_WLS_MAP_MSE', [truth]+risk_row)
    print('truth_MAP_bias_variance', truth, float(np.mean(np.array(errors)[:,2])), float(np.var(np.array(errors)[:,2])))
assert np.allclose(risk_rows,[[20,5/4,4/5,5/9],[22,5/4,4/5,2/3],[26,5/4,4/5,14/9]],rtol=0,atol=1e-12)
bayes_errors = []
for prior_error,e1,e2 in product([-2.0,2.0],[-2.0,2.0],[-1.0,1.0]):
    truth = 20+prior_error
    bayes_errors.append((20+(truth+e1)+4*(truth+e2))/6-truth)
bayes_risk = float(np.mean(np.square(bayes_errors)))
print('integrated_linear_rule_risk',bayes_risk)
assert abs(bayes_risk-2/3)<1e-12

sample = np.array([18.0,20.0,22.0])
sample_mean = float(np.mean(sample))
sse = float(np.sum((sample-sample_mean)**2))
print('unknown_variance_mean_SSE_ML_unbiased',sample_mean,sse,sse/3,sse/2)
assert np.allclose([sample_mean,sse,sse/3,sse/2],[20,8,8/3,4],rtol=0,atol=1e-12)
outlier_sample = np.array([20.0,20.0,20.0,20.0,30.0])
mean,median = float(np.mean(outlier_sample)),float(np.median(outlier_sample))
losses = [float(np.sum((outlier_sample-mean)**2)),float(np.sum((outlier_sample-median)**2)),float(np.sum(abs(outlier_sample-mean))),float(np.sum(abs(outlier_sample-median)))]
print('different_model_mean_median',mean,median)
print('SSE_at_mean_median_L1_at_mean_median',losses)
assert [mean,median] == [22.0,20.0]
assert losses == [80.0,100.0,16.0,10.0]
